comment: Extraction results on Magic's own output that differ from the checked parameters, seen in
the first sweep of ihp-sg13g2 (2026-11-21, Magic 8.3.681). Both sides (Magic's GDS and the PCell's
GDS) must still give the same netlist; a point that matches an entry here passes the identity
check as a known Magic behaviour, and the report lists it.
